texts: A few Keepers each keep a notebook that lists moth-counts and weather notes.

fields.sentence: A few Keepers each keep a notebook that lists moth-counts and weather notes.
parse: (: keepers_rule (Implication (PartOf $x sk_group_1) (And (Member (sk_keep $x) keep) (Agent (sk_keep $x) $x) (Theme (sk_keep $x) (sk_notebook $x)) (Member (sk_notebook $x) notebook) (Member (sk_list $x) list) (Agent (sk_list $x) (sk_notebook $x)) (Theme (sk_list $x) moth_count) (Theme (sk_list $x) weather_note))) (STV 1.0 0.9))

q1_issues.issue: The coordinated object of the relative clause ("lists moth-counts and weather notes") is collapsed into one `list` event carrying two `Theme` atoms, whereas Coordination & plurals makes coordinated NPs distributive by default (replicate the predication once per conjunct), the one-event/multiple-role form being reserved for reciprocal/aggregate predicates.

q2_gaps: a capitalized plural kind-word label under a quantifier ("A few Keepers") — the capitalized-common-noun default is declared "singular-collective only", and the plural rule is stated only for a label "referring as a name", so a counted/indefinite capitalized plural is addressed by neither branch
review.notes: Group + CardinalityPhrase "a few" + group event + per-member rule over (PartOf $x sk_group_1) with the "each" QuantifierPhrase companion matches the counted-plural-with-distributive-predicate doctrine, and both compound genera (moth_count, weather_note) correctly withhold the noun-modifier genus.

issues.reason: Coordination & plurals makes a coordinated NP distributive by default — replicate the whole predication once per conjunct, verbal to one event each — and reserves the one-event/many-role form for reciprocal or aggregate predicates, which 'list' is not, so filling one event's Theme slot twice violates a stated rule.

gaps_confirmed: a counted / indefinite capitalized plural kind-word label ('A few Keepers'): the capitalized-common-noun default is declared singular-collective only, and the plural carve-out covers only a label referring as a name, so neither branch decides a quantified capitalized plural
adjudication.defect_summary: The relative clause should replicate per conjunct — two per-keeper listing events, (Member (sk_lista $x) list) (Agent (sk_lista $x) (sk_notebook $x)) (Theme (sk_lista $x) moth_count) and a parallel sk_listb event with weather_note — rather than one list event carrying two Theme atoms.
adjudication.notes: Everything else holds: the stative-transitive 'lists' correctly takes Agent on the notebook (the 'manifest lists two pallets' precedent), the dependent existentials are proper Skolem functions of $x, 'a few' correctly takes CardinalityPhrase rather than a proportion strength, and both compound genera withhold the noun-modifier genus.
